test_name: Personnel Security - PS-3 with Critical Cross-Cutting Failure
architecture:
System: Records-Service-142
Primary NIST family: Personnel Security (PS); evidence focus: PS-3.
Family control evidence: termination workflow promptly revokes logical and physical access and recovers organizational assets. Critical observed condition: a shared administrator credential file is stored in an S3 bucket without encryption. Other controls may be configured correctly, but the observed condition is current production evidence.
